text:
Nora: Starting a staged canary for v2.6.0. Target 25% over 40m. Change window 11:00-12:00 UTC. Beginning with EU slice at 11:00. /deploy release=v2.6.0 percent=5->25 slice=eu

deploy-bot: [11:00:06] Deploy initiated: v2.6.0 -> canary 5% (EU). CI green. Dashboard: https://deploy.internal/r/3429991111

Sam: Watching EU metrics. Thresholds: hold if p95>210ms or errors>0.4%.

Ethan: Early metric: p95 EU = 198ms, errors 0.3%. trending ok but will keep close eye.

deploy-bot: [11:12:30] Scheduled ramp: 5% -> 15% in 10m. Safety checks: kv-cache-pressure=false, oom_risk=low.

Nora: Quick note: If we must pin, prefer pin-region eu->v2.5.8 rather than full rollback to reduce global disruption.

Ethan: @sre-oncall I see a backend queue spike in eu-west at 11:14, qps +45%. Might be a transient.

sre-oncall: Investigating: `./ops/queue_check --region=eu --since=15m` shows spike coincident with cache TTL flush. Could be correlated with small config change earlier.

Sam: p95 now at 226ms and errors 0.6% in eu-west. Recommend pause and pin if it stays >200 for 3 consecutive minutes.

Nora: Pausing ramp. @deploy-bot apply-pin region=eu version=v2.5.8 reason="queue spike and p95/error breach"

deploy-bot: [11:18:02] Action: ramp paused. EU pinned to v2.5.8. Global canary remains at 12% excluding EU. No automatic rollback executed.

product-ops: Drafting release note: "EU slice paused at ~12% due to elevated latency; pinned to stable 2.5.8 while investigation proceeds."

Ethan: QA will run a targeted regression in eu-like env for cache-heavy prompts. ETA 35m.

sre-oncall: Infra follow-up: rolling back recent config bump on cache layer in eu-west now; monitoring for queue stabilization.

Nora: Plan: wait for infra stabilization + QA green. If unresolved by 12:00 UTC, schedule staged rollback for EU at 12:10. Otherwise we can unpin and resume with a 5% gradual step.

Sam: Filing ticket INC-4509 and attaching traces + grafana.

deploy-bot: [11:20:15] Note: release notes auto-draft created at https://docs.internal/releases/v2.6.0-draft. Reminder: change window ends 12:00 UTC; auto-rollback timer set for 12:10 for region=eu if not cleared.
